scope: post-generation optimization of the generated applied playbook; Vibe itself is frozen during this subprocess

entry.requires: first runnable generated playbook candidate has passed baseline deterministic/runtime simulation qualification

forbidden: mutating Vibe to make its own improvement test pass
changing canonical Ordo semantics to hide adapter/runtime defects

anti_cheat.fixture_immutability: after a revision run begins, its response fixtures may not be changed in response to output, score, or evaluator feedback
anti_cheat.optimizer_rule: optimizer may repair the playbook, never the frozen fixture for a failed run
anti_cheat.new_fixture_rule: any fixture change creates a new immutable test-set version and does not overwrite prior evidence
anti_cheat.evaluator_separation: response simulator and evaluator are distinct responsibilities; optimizer receives scores/sanitized deficits, not hidden expected outputs
anti_cheat.holdout: required when sufficient independent scenarios exist; hidden expected outcomes are inaccessible to optimizer before final evaluation
anti_cheat.adversarial: include scenarios designed to detect exemplar memorization, answer shaping, leakage, and overfitting
anti_cheat.model_response_provenance: In PSEUDO_LIVE_OPTIMIZATION, blind synthetic responses bound to exact effective-input hashes are allowed and must be marked PSEUDO_LIVE_SYNTHETIC; in LIVE_ACCEPTANCE every executed model response requires live/exact-live-replay provenance. Pseudo responses are never formal acceptance evidence.
anti_cheat.result_artifact_lineage: Score only exact artifact materialized by declared candidate graph; surrogate/control/post-repaired documents are ineligible.
anti_cheat.fail_closed_scoring: Pseudo provenance failure blocks pseudo scoring only. Missing/failed live provenance makes formal scores unavailable but must not stop an otherwise valid pseudo-live offline optimization loop.
anti_cheat.pseudo_live_generator: freeze simulator policy/config for the evaluation regime; simulator is blind to target score, evaluator-only golden/reference content, future outputs, competing candidates and rankings; never rewrite a response after observing score

cycle: run deterministic/static checks first and repair deterministic hard failures before any model simulation
select PSEUDO_LIVE_OPTIMIZATION for offline iterations unless the candidate has already converged and LIVE_ACCEPTANCE was explicitly entered

for every model node actually executed in pseudo-live mode, build the exact effective input/context hash and generate a blind PSEUDO_LIVE_SYNTHETIC response under the frozen simulator policy; regenerate when the input hash changes
execute the candidate graph through declared materialization; surrogate/helper-generated artifacts are forbidden
verify pseudo provenance + exact artifact lineage and compute process_score, pseudo_result_score and pseudo_playbook_score; do not populate formal score fields
diagnose pseudo score loss and defect ownership; repair generated playbook only and repeat until convergence/budget
freeze best offline candidate as OFFLINE_CONVERGED_PENDING_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE
only then run LIVE_ACCEPTANCE with real calls/exact-live-replay and calculate formal scores after provenance PASS

best_so_far.monotonic_rule: a worse revision never replaces the best-so-far candidate
best_so_far.return_rule: highest_scoring_valid_revision by development_score among protected-dimension-eligible valid revisions; eligibility_rule applies first and LIVE_ACCEPTANCE remains a later non-substitutable evidence gate
best_so_far.eligibility_rule: candidate must be VALID, hard-eligible, and show no regression in any protected QUALITY_OPTIMIZATION_GOVERNANCE dimension before development_score ranking is considered
best_so_far.ranking_rule: among protected-dimension-eligible candidates only, strictly greater development_score may replace best-so-far; numeric score can never override a protected-dimension regression or hard guard failure

analyst_interaction.business_owned_unknown: record as unresolved limitation; continue every optimization possible without asking

termination.best_comparison: protected-dimension eligibility first; then strictly greater development_score among eligible candidates only; equal score is non-improving
termination.streak_semantics: after each valid evaluated run, first apply protected-dimension/hard-eligibility gates. An ineligible revision never replaces best. For eligible revisions, update best only if development_score is greater than pre-run best; then apply the declared stagnation streak semantics.
termination.on_stop: return protected-dimension-eligible valid best-so-far exact revision with highest development_score, never latest by default
termination.stagnation_streak_definition: count consecutive valid evaluated revisions that do not produce an eligible strict development_score improvement over current best; protected-dimension-ineligible revisions are non-improving and never replace best
termination.cycle_budget_rule: hard safety budget independent of stagnation; reaching it stops the run and returns best-so-far
termination.invalid_revision_streak_rule: consecutive HARD_UNSCORABLE revisions are counted independently from valid-run stagnation and terminate at the limit

quality_evaluation.ranking: strictly greater development_score wins; ties do not replace best-so-far
quality_evaluation.thresholds: none; development_score guides ranking and diagnosis; acceptance_score is evidence-gated and never used as a substitute subjective objective
quality_evaluation.next_iteration_input: consolidated mechanical artifact defects plus deterministic process-integrity defects plus sanitized comparative defects plus mechanically verified positive reward opportunities (including missed reusable-pattern fits); never full golden references
quality_evaluation.diagnosis_rule: numeric development_score never stands alone; optimizer must consume scorer-emitted defects/remediation and positive reward opportunities. It may repair only the candidate playbook, never frozen grader/reference fixtures, and may claim reusable-pattern reward only from deterministic pre-library eligibility + exact final graph-realization evidence. Treat unsupported human-authority values as invalid revisions, not as a way to avoid analyst questions; prefer justified derivation, accepted sources, or an explicit authority interaction. Penalize only proven redundant variables, never useful Data-Layer richness. Respect non-double-counting interaction suppression and the reusable-pattern reward cap.
quality_evaluation.grader_freeze: freeze mechanical rubric, analytical rubric, eligible references and evaluator criteria across a revision-comparison loop
quality_evaluation.fresh_reference_comparison: required on every scored revision before prior-defect regression confirmation
quality_evaluation.reference_isolation: full golden artifacts evaluator-only; optimizer receives sanitized class/depth remediation targets

pattern_reuse_reward.missed_fit: surface as +50 potential opportunity without applying a penalty
pattern_reuse_reward.anti_gaming: eligibility is frozen before library lookup and duplicate/pattern-created responsibilities receive no reward

quality_evaluation.redundant_variable_policy: penalize only mechanically proven redundant variables; useful internal variables are free
quality_evaluation.interaction_penalty_stacking: group-collapse suppresses cross-group for same interaction; independent harms may stack

evaluation_regime.change_semantics: any identity field change starts a new non-comparable evaluation regime
